format: zip of a multi-member dNN-- group

routes.question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d15-- member whose basename ends stripped.elf. Read the ELF e_machine field and submit its unsigned base-10 numeric value.

In evidence.zip, Use the unique d15-- member whose basename ends symbolized.elf. Scan the specified member for literal HCFG magic and accept the first record whose bounds, CRC32, and decoded JSON validate.
In evidence.zip, Use the unique d16-- member whose basename ends compact.wasm. Classify final bytes by magic.
In evidence.zip, Use the unique d16-- member whose basename ends direct.wasm. Parse the WebAssembly section stream.
In evidence.zip, Use the unique d21-- member whose basename ends loader.elf. Read the ELF e_machine field and submit its unsigned base-10 numeric value.
In evidence.zip, Use the unique d21-- member whose basename ends plugin.cmxs. Read the ELF e_machine field and submit its unsigned base-10 numeric value.

In evidence.zip, Use the d21-- plugin.cmxs member; the loader has no scored HCFG config. Scan the specified member for literal HCFG magic and accept the first record whose bounds, CRC32, and decoded JSON validate.

In evidence.zip, Use the unique d21-- member whose basename ends plugin.cmxs. Scan the specified member for literal HCFG magic and accept the first record whose bounds, CRC32, and decoded JSON validate.
In evidence.zip, Use all d21-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Scan the specified member for literal HCFG magic and accept the first record whose bounds, CRC32, and decoded JSON validate.
In evidence.zip, Use all d15-- members in ZIP central-directory order.

generator_cmd: FX=$PWD bash route_gen.sh   # gcc -shared -Wl,-soname / gcc -ldl, strip, wat2wasm, python3 zlib.crc32 header, zip -X -j
oracle_cmd: bash route_oracle.sh route_days.bin   # unzip -Z1, readelf -hW/-lW/-dW/--dyn-syms, strings, grep -obUa HCFG + binascii.crc32
note: D15 / D16 / D21 question shapes (verbatim prefixes from the D21 contract)
